purpose: Prioritize familiar short candidates that pair with unused approved words. Thirty-four candidates have three to five letters. Familiarity remains subject to owner review.
method: Exclude all previously reviewed spellings. Inspect meanings individually. Test independent seven-tile, five-answer layouts with four approved partners and at least one unused approval.
limitations: The owner skipped all fifty; none is approved. Nine candidates have no confirmed board in this bounded search. Independent examples do not establish a joint campaign, 75-level spacing, chapter pacing, extension capacity or repetition percentage. Production content is unchanged.
sourceAttribution: Georgian explanatory dictionary: Linguistic Technologies Group. Wiktionary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0; individual URLs, revision IDs and hashes retained. Brief adapted glosses only. See content/dictionaries/README.md for licensing.
